quote: I've had my hair cut in four cities and Mara is the first person who asked how I actually wear it. Six weeks later it still falls right.
name: Hannah R.

quote: Theo fixed a box-dye mistake in one visit and told me the price before he started. The colour is exactly what I showed him.
name: Priya S.

quote: The facial was quiet, unhurried and nobody tried to sell me a cupboard of products afterwards.
name: Carmen D.

quote: My gel manicure lasted three full weeks. June is meticulous and the tools come out of a sealed pouch every time.
name: Lena W.
